description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into 14 slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories and their corresponding approximate percentages are: from (blue, 17.00%), to (yellow, 14.50%), genre (dark green, 13.50%), name (dark blue, 5.20%), size (blue, 4.20%), time (light green, 4.10%), intent (yellow, 3.80%), location (light green, 3.80%), destination (yellow, 3.00%), city (yellow, 2.60%), class (yellow, 2.40%), range (yellow, 2.20%), type (yellow, 2.00%), beds (grey, 1.30%), and passengers (light grey, 1.10%). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, connected by lines to their corresponding categories, and the slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions.
